Proven track record connecting product strategy and platform design , turning growth and brand objectives into concrete architectural choices for audiences, campaign orchestration and website capabilities. Strong technical leadership skills : setting architectural direction, driving design reviews, evolving engineering standards and mentoring senior engineers and tech leaders. Experience with experimentation and data‑driven decision making , and with designing systems that are observable, instrumented and easy to reason about. Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments , collaborating with Product, Data, Design, Marketing and other platform teams to align priorities and manage dependencies. Comfort operating in high‑visibility, cross‑impact domains , where platform decisions have direct effect on growth and brand outcomes. High tolerance for ambiguity , with the ability to frame complex problems into clear options and drive alignment through structured written and verbal communication. Nice to have Background in growth, martech or CRM platforms . Experience in multi‑country or multi‑brand environments . title: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de JaneiroRJ
description: CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Neste contexto a AVSI irá operacionalizar um projeto no Município do Rio de Janeiro e em algumas áreas da baixada fluminense, com objetivo de mobilização social, organização comunitária e atividades correlatas, visando ao engajamento e à integração das comunidades nos municípios de atuação da empresa que são localizados no estado do Rio de Janeiro, com predominância nas regiões metropolitanas e capital. O foco está na sensibilização sobre as atividades sociais da empresa através de momentos educativos, alinhando transparência, inclusão e bem‑estar da população atendida. Poderão ser promovidos eventos, com objetivo de ativar outros parceiros, para consolidar a relação de confiança entre a empresa e a população local, criando marketing positivo e desenvolvimento das comunidades. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO O Gerente de Projeto será responsável pela gestão integral do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento das diretrizes contratuais e dos procedimentos da AVSI. Essa função abrange a coordenação completa do ciclo do projeto, integrando aspectos gerenciais e administrativos, com responsabilidade final pelo planejamento e execução das atividades, gerenciamento da equipe dedicada, mobilização das comunidades, suporte técnico e administrativo, além do desenvolvimento de metodologias de controle e logística para assegurar a execução eficiente e os resultados esperados. PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO Gerenciar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI. Organizar as atividades do projeto nos seus aspectos operacionais e administrativos, apresentando relatórios ao responsável preposto. Auxiliar na solicitação de compras previstas no Plano de Aquisição aprovado, garantindo a correta descrição de bens e serviços para o setor de aquisições. Selecionar, coordenar, supervisionar, monitorar e avaliar a equipe técnica do programa. Aplicar rigorosamente os procedimentos e regras estabelecidos nos manuais da AVSI. Manter atualizado o arquivo de documentos no sistema de PATRIMONIALIZAÇÃO da AVSI. Enviar periodicamente ao setor de Comunicação materiais sobre o projeto para publicação. Contribuir para a elaboração de documentos descritivos necessários à prestação de contas do projeto. Representar a AVSI no diálogo e na relação técnica com a equipe da contratante. Realizar missões e atividades em outros territórios ou escritórios da AVSI no Brasil, quando necessário. Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios internos destinados ao cliente. Participar de reuniões e conferências periódicas, sempre que solicitado. Desenvolver o programa de acordo com as especificações técnicas do contrato, respeitando prazos, escopo e conteúdos previamente estabelecidos. Executar os processos necessários para a plena realização das atividades previstas no programa. Gerenciar a execução técnica das atividades, assegurando que os conteúdos, metodologias, estruturas e equipamentos sejam aplicados de maneira favorável ao alcance dos objetivos propostos. Coordenar a mobilização e promover o diálogo para engajamento do público‑alvo. Articular parcerias com outras organizações para fortalecer as ações do programa. Organizar a logística de campo, elaborando documentos comprobatórios que evidenciem o desenvolvimento das atividades realizadas. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internas. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Head of Customer Proposition
description: About the Role We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day. Not remote: This is a hybrid role in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. We are looking for a commercially driven and customer-centric Head of Customer Proposition to join our Brazil team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the local 360° customer proposition strategy across our core product verticals, including Sports, Gaming and Social . As a senior leader within the Brazil Commercial organisation, you will oversee the ideation, development and execution of market-leading propositions that attract, engage, reward and retain customers throughout their lifecycle. You will lead a team of local product vertical experts and work cross-functionally to ensure our customer experiences are locally relevant, insight-led and commercially impactful. Working closely with the Commercial Director, Brazil, and wider regional and global stakeholders, you will shape and execute the local proposition strategy aligned to broader regional objectives, ensuring we deliver standout experiences that strengthen customer loyalty, increase engagement and drive sustainable growth in the Brazilian market. This role requires a deep understanding of the Brazilian betting and gaming landscape, strong commercial acumen, and a passion for delivering best-in-class customer experiences through innovation, personalisation and operational excellence. What You’ll Be Doing Define and lead the Brazil customer proposition strategy across Sports, Gaming and Social verticals, aligned to wider regional and global business objectives. Develop and execute a local proposition roadmap that enhances customer engagement, retention, cross-sell and lifetime value. Lead and develop a high-performing team of vertical managers/leads, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability and customer obsession. Partner with senior commercial and marketing stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities, market trends and competitive advantages within the Brazilian market. Customer Lifecycle, Retention & Engagement Collaborate with CRM to oversee the development and optimisation of lifecycle and customer journeys across acquisition, onboarding, retention, reactivation and higher-value segments. Ensure generosity and customer value are delivered effectively throughout key customer moments and major sporting and entertainment events. Drive advanced segmentation and personalisation strategies to create relevant, timely, and differentiated customer experiences. Collaborate with CRM and Performance teams to build sophisticated, data-led communication plans that improve engagement and long-term retention. Commercial Performance & Optimisation Own the proposition bonus and promotional investment strategy across all verticals, ensuring strong budget governance, efficiency and ROI. Monitor and optimise proposition performance against key commercial KPIs including retention, conversion, cross-sell, active days, engagement and customer value. Lead the Test & Learn roadmap for Brazil, identifying and prioritising experiments that improve customer and commercial outcomes. Use customer insights, analytics, and market intelligence to continuously evolve proposition performance and identify new growth opportunities. Product & Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Product, GTM, Commercial, BI, CRM, Performance Marketing, Operations and Brand teams to ensure seamless proposition delivery and execution. Ensure alignment between local commercial priorities and the central Sports, Gaming and Social product roadmaps. Support acquisition strategies by optimising propositions and promotional mechanics to improve marketing efficiency and conversion performance. Collaborate with Analytics and Performance teams to build best-in-class reporting frameworks and performance dashboards to inform strategic decision-making. Market & Regulatory Excellence Maintain a strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape and ensure all proposition activity complies with local requirements and responsible gaming standards. Stay informed on competitor activity, customer behaviours and emerging market trends to ensure propositions remain innovative and market-leading. Champion a customer-first approach across all proposition initiatives and touchpoints. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in a senior proposition or commercial leadership role, ideally within the iGaming, sports betting or digital e-commerce/fintech space. Strong knowledge of the Brazilian betting, gaming, and digital consumer landscape. Proven experience building and executing customer proposition and retention strategies across multiple verticals. Strong commercial and analytical acumen with experience managing promotional budgets and performance KPIs. Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders. Proven track record of managing and developing high-potential teams and individuals. This role involves direct role management responsibility. Deep understanding of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, personalisation, cross-sell and engagement strategies. Experience leading Test & Learn initiatives and using data-driven insights to optimise customer and commercial performance. Ability to oversee complex cross-functional initiatives/projects to completion and deliver successful business outcomes Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Passion for innovation, customer experience, and delivering market-leading propositions. Preferred Experience Experience across Sportsbook, Casino/Gaming and Social or community-led products. Familiarity with onsite/crm tools, bonus engines, and customer analytics tools. Experience operating within a fast-paced, high-growth, and regulated environment. Understanding of responsible gaming principles and local compliance requirements in Brazil. About Super We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide. Shaping the Future of Play Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page: super.xyz/careers Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA). At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance. This position is based in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. In your daily routine, you will be led 100% in English. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Neste contexto a AVSI irá operacionalizar um projeto no Municipio do Rio de Janeiro e em algumas áreas da baixada fluminense, com objetivo de mobilização social, organização comunitária e atividades correlatas, visando ao engajamento e a integração das comunidades nos municípios de atuação da empresa que são localizados no estado do Rio de Janeiro, com predominância nas regiões metropolitanas e capital. O foco está na sensibilização sobre as atividades sociais da empresa através de momentos educativos, alinhando transparência, inclusão e bem-estar da população atendida. Poderão ser promovidos eventos, com objetivo de ativar outros parceiros, para consolidar a relação de confiança entre a empresa e a população local, criando marketing positivo e desenvolvimento das comunidades. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Gerente de Projeto será responsável pela gestão integral do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento das diretrizes contratuais e dos procedimentos da AVSI. Essa função abrange a coordenação completa do ciclo do projeto, integrando aspectos gerenciais e administrativos, com responsabilidade final pelo planejamento e execução das atividades, gerenciamento da equipe dedicada, mobilização das comunidades, suporte técnico e administrativo, além do desenvolvimento de metodologias de controle e logística para assegurar a execução eficiente e os resultados esperados. Gerenciar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI. Organizar as atividades do projeto nos seus aspectos operacionais e administrativos, apresentando relatórios ao responsável preposto. Auxiliar na solicitação de compras previstas no Plano de Aquisição aprovado, garantindo a correta descrição de bens e serviços para o setor de aquisições. Selecionar, coordenar, supervisionar, monitorar e avaliar a equipe técnica do programa. Aplicar rigorosamente os procedimentos e regras estabelecidos nos manuais da AVSI. Manter atualizado o arquivo de documentos no sistema de PATRIMONIALIZAÇÃO da AVSI. Enviar periodicamente ao setor de Comunicação materiais sobre o projeto para publicação. Contribuir para a elaboração de documentos descritivos necessários à prestação de contas do projeto. Representar a AVSI no diálogo e na relação técnica com a equipe da contratante. Realizar missões e atividades em outros territórios ou escritórios da AVSI no Brasil, quando necessário. Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios internos destinados ao cliente. Participar de reuniões e conferências periódicas, sempre que solicitado. Desenvolver o programa de acordo com as especificações técnicas do contrato, respeitando prazos, escopo e conteúdos previamente estabelecidos. Executar os processos necessários para a plena realização das atividades previstas no programa. Gerenciar a execução técnica das atividades, assegurando que os conteúdos, metodologias, estruturas e equipamentos sejam aplicados de maneira favorável ao alcance dos objetivos propostos. Coordenar a mobilização e promover o diálogo para engajamento do público-alvo. Articular parcerias com outras organizações para fortalecer ações do programa. Organizar a logística de campo, elaborando documentos comprobatórios que evidenciem o desenvolvimento das atividades realizadas. title: Mechanical & Rotating Engineer
description: Airswift is seeking a Mechanical and Rotating Equipment Engineer (Onshore) to work in Rio de Janeiro in a permanent position with an Oil and Gas Company. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Act as a Technical Authority (Integrity) to evaluate and respond to Management of Change (MOC) and Technical Assistance (TA) requests. Lead Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA/RCA) and develop reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems), ensuring compliance with company standards and international codes, increasing MTBF and reducing downtime. Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with company standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT). Issue Technical Notes and Guidelines as a recognized subject matter expert, standardizing practices and lessons learned. Ensure complete documentation, traceability, and clear communication with onshore/offshore stakeholders. Monitor the performance of rotating equipment using PDM/CBM techniques: vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis (including ferrography and spectroscopy) for early anomaly detection. Supervise and execute Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions. Develop and implement condition-based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime. Develop and implement reliability and maintenance (RCM) strategies, with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost. Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems; recommend corrective actions. Identify and manage problematic components, conduct disposal plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements. Lead the ACR for recurring failures and problems using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify the effectiveness of actions. Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements. Provide daily technical support to Operations and Maintenance areas to resolve machine problems, unplanned downtime, and optimize control/operating parameters. Offer guidance for commissioning/start-up, operations, reviews, and updates of controls/monitoring for rotating equipment. Support capital projects by reviewing maintainability and reliability specifications and ensuring correct installation/alignment according to API/AGMA/ISO standards. Support the preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (ART) and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and systems. JOB QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. MBA/Postgraduate degree in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus. Advanced English required. Experience in operation, maintenance, or reliability of rotating equipment in the Oil and Gas sector (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery. Solid knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services. Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and fault diagnosis. Proven experience in troubleshooting and field condition monitoring. Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machine design, lubrication, mechanical seals (including dry gas seals). Rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis. Practical knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816). In‑depth knowledge of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, dry gas seal systems, and gearboxes. Certification in vibration analysis (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desirable; certifications in oil analysis/thermography are an advantage. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Identify, manage, and collaborate with influencers, brand ambassadors, broadcasters, and partners to amplify reach and engagement. Stay up to date on social media trends, tools, and best practices. Execute social campaigns including contests, giveaways, and product launches. Coordinate cross-platform campaigns to ensure consistent messaging and maximum impact. Work closely with marketing, PR, creative services, and other departments to support overall business goals. Collaborate with content creators, designers, and copywriters to produce high-quality content. Act as the primary social media liaison between the Zurich-based global team and the US-based event teams. Adjust strategies based on data to improve reach, engagement, and conversion rates. Ensure collaboration and content optimisation with other stakeholders in the Digital Marketing group, including colleagues working on owned-and-operated platforms YOUR PROFILE Education & Qualifications Related bachelor’s degree or a similar level of higher education. Work Experience Minimum 5 years' experience developing social media campaigns for sports teams, paid social campaigns, creating social content, and leadership responsibilities (preferably in the South American market). Ability to understand and execute brand guidelines. Proficiency across Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), TikTok, Snapchat, YouTube, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Languages Fluent in English and Portuguese Technology Experience/Proficiency with Google Analytics, Keyhole, Canva, PowerPoint, Hootsuite, Buffer, Sprout Social, Sprinklr, Adobe Creative Cloud. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança, qualidade, meio ambiente e procedimentos internos da empresa. Promover treinamentos, orientações técnicas e desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe de manutenção. Atuar na investigação de ocorrências, avarias e acidentes relacionados à frota, propondo ações para mitigação de riscos. Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de manutenção, ERP e controle de frota. Conhecimento das normas de segurança aplicáveis às atividades de manutenção. title: TÉCNICO DE NUTRIÇÃO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description: Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Auxiliar o nutricionista nas atividades de gerenciamento da unidade e orientar funcionários no preparo e distribuição de alimentos. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino Médio completo Curso de Técnico de Nutrição completo Experiência: 6 meses efetivo ou estágio com Comprovação / Termo Compromisso de Estágio (estágios realizados interna e externamente). description: Descrição da vaga No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas. São elas que impulsionam ideias, constroem marcas e fazem a moda acontecer todos os dias. Sobre a posição Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Projetos Estratégicos para atuar diretamente com a liderança de Tecnologia, dentro da nossa iniciativa de IA corporativa. É uma posição para quem gosta de entrar em problemas complexos, conduzir análises profundas com autonomia e sair com recomendações que geram decisão e impacto. O trabalho é variado por natureza: a cada ciclo, uma oportunidade diferente do negócio — identificada pela alta liderança — pode virar o seu próximo projeto. O que você vai fazer Atuar como braço analítico ligado diretamente ao diretor de Tecnologia. À medida que a alta liderança identifica oportunidades relevantes no negócio, esta posição é alocada para entrar no problema, conduzir a análise de ponta a ponta e sair com recomendações concretas e acionáveis — atuando também na implementação quando o projeto pedir. O que buscamos 4 a 5 anos de experiência em funções analíticas exigentes — consultoria estratégica, estratégia/BizOps, M&A, banco de investimento, ou áreas equivalentes. Capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos e conduzi-los até uma recomendação concreta com pouca supervisão. Fluência ou disposição genuína em usar ferramentas de IA como parte central do trabalho analítico. Autonomia, senso de dono e maturidade para navegar diferentes áreas do grupo. Diferenciais (nice to have) Experiência em concepção ou desenvolvimento de produtos/projetos digitais. Vivência em ambientes de varejo, moda, e-commerce ou bens de consumo. Responsabilidades e atribuições Decompor problemas de negócio ambíguos em hipóteses claras, frentes de análise e um plano de ataque — partindo de um direcionamento inicial da liderança e conduzindo o resto com autonomia. Conduzir análises quantitativas e qualitativas robustas: estruturar dados, dimensionar oportunidades, modelar cenários e pressionar as próprias conclusões antes de apresentá-las. Entregar complete staff work: chegar até o final do raciocínio e apresentar recomendações prontas para decisão, com trade-offs explícitos e premissas declaradas — não análises em aberto que devolvem o problema para quem pediu. Usar ferramentas de IA como alavanca central de análise — acelerando pesquisa, processamento de dados, prototipagem de soluções e geração de insumos para decisão. Traduzir análise em comunicação executiva: documentos e apresentações diretos, bem estruturados e proporcionais à decisão em jogo, voltados a CEO e diretoria. Participar da implementação das recomendações quando aplicável — acompanhando execução, ajustando o curso com base em resultados e garantindo que a análise vire impacto real. Trabalhar lado a lado com as áreas donas de cada problema, navegando contextos distintos do grupo (marcas, varejo, operações, digital) sem gerar atrito de "área que audita área". As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector. Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively. Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations. Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details. Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modification schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements. Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation. Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance. Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements. Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance. Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management. Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity. Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality. Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment. Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions. Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions. Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence. Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly. Qualifications and Experience Engineering degree is mandatory. CREA‑RJ accreditation is required. Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage. Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred. Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable. Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders. Why Join Us? At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment. If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Profissional Web Designer Sênior
description: Headquarters: BR URL: A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. Além da nossa atuação pelo Brasil, com escritório no Rio de janeiro, São Paulo e Belo Horizonte, temos também filiais nos Estados Unidos, fazendo com que a Radix se consolide cada vez mais como uma empresa global. Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade? Como Web Designer você vai: Responsabilidades Executar atividades de design em projetos variados, garantindo qualidade e aderência aos prazos e objetivos acordados; Criar interfaces e experiências inovadoras, incorporando soluções de Inteligência Artificial (AI) e Generative AI (GenAI) para otimização de fluxos, personalização de conteúdo e automação de interações; Manter-se atualizado quanto às metodologias e ferramentas de UX/UI e AI/GenAI, promovendo inovação nos projetos; Realizar pesquisas com usuários, desenvolver personas, mapear jornadas do usuário e construir protótipos de baixa e alta fidelidade; Testar e validar experiências com usuários, coletando feedbacks e refinando interações suportadas por AI/GenAI; Colaborar com equipes de Produto, Engajamento e Comercial, integrando insights de AI/GenAI para melhorar a experiência do usuário; Contribuir para a excelência da equipe de Design, promovendo mentorias, revisões e treinamentos; Desenvolver interfaces funcionais utilizando frameworks fornecidos pelo cliente ou plataformas de desenvolvimento de mercado, incorporando componentes de AI/GenAI quando aplicável. Pré-Requisitos Inglês avançado para conversação; Experiência sólida com UX/UI, incluindo prototipagem para web e aplicativos (desktop, tablet, mobile); Conhecimento em Design Thinking e metodologias centradas no usuário; Experiência prática ou interesse em AI e GenAI aplicado a interfaces e experiências digitais; Ter portfólio robusto, demonstrando habilidades em design de interface e experiência do usuário; Ter proficiência em Figma e Adobe XD. Desejável Conhecimentos básicos em CSS e HTML; Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban); Experiência em ferramentas de colaboração (Miro, InVision); Experiência na integração de AI/GenAI em fluxos de UX, automação e personalização de interfaces. Benefícios Assistência Médica Nacional (para o titular e dependentes, com quarto privativo) Assistência odontológica nacional (para o titular e dependentes) Vale refeição / alimentação flexível Auxílio home office Day off (no mês do aniversário) Wellhub (antigo Gympass) Licença Maternidade (6 meses) e Paternidade (20 dias) estendidas Auxílio creche para filhos de até 3 anos (por filho) Apoio em saúde mental com a Wellz Clube de Vantagens com descontos em diversos parceiros Convênio com instituições de ensino e cursos de idioma Desenvolvimento Profissional (Universidade Corporativa) Parceria com empresa de coworkings no Brasil Programa de Qualidade de Vida e Bem-Estar Médico consultor para acompanhamento de radixers Planos de incentivos A Radix está sempre no topo das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar porque: Temos profissionais comprometidos, dedicados, curiosos e inovadores. O espírito de equipe é a nossa maior força. Trabalhamos de forma cooperativa e sabemos que estamos juntos, remando na mesma direção. Temos um ambiente diverso, que valoriza equidade e inclusão. Nossa jornada de trabalho é flexível e em quase todos os projetos é possível trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Valorizamos o bem-estar e o cuidado com as nossas pessoas, com programas de apoio à saúde mental, psiquiatra e médico consultor disponíveis. Você distingue prontamente entre o que é relevante e o que é irrelevante para compreender situações complexas. Você encontra pontos em comum e conduz as coisas para o consenso, garantindo que todos se sintam ouvidos. Você utiliza insights dos clientes para impulsionar e orientar o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam constantemente. Para este cargo, você precisará: Formação Técnica em Automação; Ter experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore); Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação; Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office; Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition etc; Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais; Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente; Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14; Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ; Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado. Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você: Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Accommodation Coordinator
description: Accommodation Coordinator Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION Reporting organizationally to the Accommodation Manager in Rio de Janeiro, the Accommodation Coordinator will help serve accommodation efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ as it hosts 32 teams and 700+ players across Brazil and 8 host cities/venues. This role will be responsible for coordinating lodging and hotel-related arrangements for the event, ensuring a smooth and comfortable experience for teams, participants and attendees. Further, this role will have a range of responsibilities, including contracting hotels, coordinating inventory, F&B, AV, meeting space, and reconciling and reporting. Minimum of 2 years of work experience in the hospitality industry. Strong communication skills – oral and written. Experience coordinating complex projects. Strong organizational, customer service and attention to detail. Fluent/Native in English and Portuguese are required for this position. Knowledge of other languages is considered a plus. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. Requirements Must have legal right to work in Brazil. Ability to relocate and work from Rio de Janeiro. Required language skills: fluent in English and Portuguese is mandatory, fluent in Spanish is a big plus. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Overview Somos uma consultoria de Engenharia de Software com mais de 15 anos de experiência em qualidade de software e elevado nível técnico quando se trata de automação de testes, segurança digital e cultura DevOps. _nunca paramos de estudar e aprender , pois estamos sempre em busca de excelência e desenvolvimento. _valorizamos nosso ambiente colaborativo , pois acreditamos na força do nosso time. _agimos com transparência e respeito , pois buscamos manter padrões éticos e morais nas nossas relações com colegas, parceiros e clientes. Como Analista AppSec Júnior na PrimeUp você irá: Apoiar a execução de análises de segurança em código-fonte (Secure Code Review), identificando vulnerabilidades e desvios de boas práticas de desenvolvimento seguro com suporte da equipe; Auxiliar na validação e triagem de vulnerabilidades identificadas por ferramentas SAST, SCA, DAST e Container Security; Apoiar equipes de desenvolvimento na compreensão e correção de vulnerabilidades, seguindo orientações e padrões definidos pela área de AppSec; Participar da análise de vulnerabilidades com base em referências como OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, CWE e CVE; Auxiliar na operação e administração das ferramentas de segurança de aplicações utilizadas pela organização; Apoiar a integração e acompanhamento de ferramentas de segurança nos processos de desenvolvimento e pipelines CI/CD; Participar do monitoramento de vulnerabilidades, acompanhando prazos de correção e indicadores de segurança; Contribuir para a disseminação das boas práticas de desenvolvimento seguro junto aos times de tecnologia; Apoiar atividades relacionadas ao Secure SDLC (SSDLC), colaborando com a implementação dos controles de segurança no ciclo de desenvolvimento. Será bacana se você também tiver: Experiência acadêmica, estágio ou projetos pessoais relacionados à segurança de aplicações. Conhecimento básico em ferramentas de SAST, DAST ou SCA, como Checkmarx, Fortify, SonarQube, Veracode ou Snyk; Conhecimento básico em APIs REST e conceitos de segurança de APIs; Noções de Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP); Conhecimento básico em containers (Docker) e Kubernetes; Conhecimento em Python, PowerShell ou Shell Script para automação; Inglês avançado para leitura, escrita e conversação. Obs.: A vaga é remota para candidatos fora das regiões metropolitanas de RJ e SP. Para residentes nas regiões metropolitanas de RJ e SP, o modelo é híbrido (1 vez por semana presencial). title: Engineering Manager, Back End - Fintech (Bangkok based, relocation provided)
description: About Agoda At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005 when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries working together in offices around the globe. Every day we connect people to destinations and experiences across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. Data Department The Data department oversees all of Agoda’s data‑related requirements. Our ultimate goal is to enable and increase the use of data in the company through creative approaches and powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, queue systems, BI tools, and data science technology. We hire bright minds from around the world to support senior growth and success within a culture of diversity and experimentation. The team plays a critical role, empowering business users, product managers, engineers, and others to make data‑driven decisions while improving search experience and protecting customers from fraud. Role Overview As an Engineering Manager, Backend/Data at Agoda, you will lead a team of talented engineers in building and scaling robust backend and data platforms that power critical products and services. This role involves designing distributed systems, data pipelines, and high‑throughput, low‑latency services, ensuring reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence. You will also work on fintech‑related platforms and transaction‑heavy systems such as payments, financial operations, and other business‑critical flows requiring accuracy, resilience, and performance. Responsibilities Lead a high‑performing engineering team while staying hands‑on with coding, code reviews, and technical guidance. Coach engineers through technical problem‑solving, design discussions, and day‑to‑day development. Architect scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems in a high‑traffic, data‑intensive environment. Drive engineering across backend services, infrastructure, performance, data, client‑facing systems, and fintech‑related platform capabilities. Own production systems, including operational health, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and security. Shape engineering best practices across software design, architecture, testing, system operations, and secure engineering. Develop people through mentoring, feedback, and career growth support. Hire and scale strong engineering talent. Partner with cross‑functional stakeholders to deliver impactful business, product, and platform outcomes. Use data‑driven decision making to improve team effectiveness and delivery. Requirements Strong hands‑on coding ability in at least one language such as Java, Scala, or C#. Experience in systems architecture and scalable, fault‑tolerant distributed systems. Experience as a system owner with operational responsibility for production services. Knowledge of lower‑level engineering concepts such as garbage collection, threading, and context switching. Exposure to automation, CI/CD, and Agile/Scrum within a DevOps culture. Good understanding of application security and secure engineering practices. Leadership of engineering teams with 5+ direct reports and a track record of building and developing talent. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, operating with ownership and autonomy. Practice data‑driven decision making in delivery and engineering management. Ability to operate effectively in environments involving transaction‑heavy, reliability‑sensitive, or fintech‑related systems. Nice to Have Proficiency in more than one programming language. Experience with large‑scale distributed systems in high‑growth or high‑traffic environments. Exposure to travel tech, e‑commerce, marketplace, or fintech platforms. Understanding of data engineering or machine learning team environments. Prior experience hiring and scaling teams rapidly. Experience working on payments, financial systems, or other transaction‑focused platforms. Hiring Process Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview. In your cover letter, tell us why you are interested in this role at the Open Society Foundations and how your design experience and values connect to our mission of advancing justice, equity, and human rights. Role Purpose The Visual Designer brings strong creative vision and technical execution to design and multimedia projects across web, mobile, social media, and print. The ideal candidate is fluent in the language of design systems, passionate about visual storytelling for advocacy, and excited to contribute to work that advances justice, human rights, and open societies. Key Responsibilities Design and deliver compelling creative for websites, social media, print materials, data visualizations, video narratives, and interactive applications. Lead the visual design and front‑end execution of digital storytelling projects – ranging from standalone microsites and data tools to motion graphics and animations. Collaborate closely with developers, writers, and campaigners to create wireframes, mock‑ups, storyboards, and prototypes that clearly communicate design intent and user interaction. Uphold and evolve Open Society’s visual identity across all mediums, supporting both internal teams and external vendors to produce on‑brand, high‑quality creative work. Manage and maintain identity guidelines, visual style libraries, and design systems to support consistent and effective visual communication. Source, edit, and produce visual content using photography and video to support campaign goals and brand messaging. Review and guide work from design contractors, consultants, and agency partners to maintain visual and strategic alignment. Participate in creative brainstorming, campaign development, and communications planning alongside a multidisciplinary digital team. The Ideal Candidate Substantial experience in visual design, with a portfolio that includes both static and interactive work. Strong proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and motion/video tools like After Effects or Premiere. Experience designing for web and mobile platforms, with a basic understanding of HTML/CSS and responsive design principles. Knowledge of UX/UI principles and experience collaborating on interactive or data‑driven products. Comfort managing brand systems and working with design partners or vendors. Excellent visual communication skills with a passion for turning complex ideas into clear, accessible visuals. Commitment to social justice, equity, and human rights. Travel Travel is required. Travel frequency depends on the role requirements. Language Fluency in English and the local language of the office location. What We Offer Exceptional opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact; from a generous annual professional development allowance for every employee to onsite training and learning conversations with visiting experts. Excellent benefits and perks to promote well‑being and a healthy work‑life balance, including: Generous time off and flexible work arrangements. Employer‑paid health insurance and dental plans for individuals and families (no employee contribution required). Exceptional retirement savings plan (non‑contributory for employees) and life insurance. Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more. A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact. Description of the Organization Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time‑limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems. Guided by our founder’s values and the belief in the art of the possible, we engage directly with global entities, individuals, and policymakers through grants, advocacy, impact investing, and strategic human rights litigation to drive positive change. At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take. Additional Information Open Society Foundations is committed to building an inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We actively seek applications from talented individuals across all backgrounds, identities, and life experiences. Each candidate is evaluated solely on their unique qualifications without regard to race, age, sex, religion, ethnic origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. Competitive rates of pay apply. Open Society Foundations is committed to advancing diversity, equity and inclusion, and to building a diverse staff that reflects the movements, issues and communities that our mission serves. Candidates from all underrepresented backgrounds, identities and communities are encouraged to apply. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants and colleagues with disabilities. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: A CARREIRA DO FARMACÊUTICO DE ASSUNTOS REGULATÓRIOS
description: A carreira farmacêutica especializada em regulação sanitária de indústrias, distribuidoras e empresas do varejo farmacêutico é uma das mais valorizadas pelo mercado de trabalho. Esta carreira possui grande projeção profissional no meio industrial e em órgãos reguladores, em que existe maior complexidade nas atividades realizadas pelo profissional, consequentemente as maiores remunerações estão em localidades que possuem polos industriais farmacêuticos, como São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Goiás, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, Brasília e Pernambuco. Ser especialista em regulação sanitária exige do profissional aptidão para tarefas administrativas, conhecimentos aprofundados em legislação sanitária nacional e internacional e capacidade de negociação, liderança, comunicação e gestão. O inglês é indispensável e o espanhol pode ser um diferencial para grandes empresas farmacêuticas brasileiras, que detêm filiais na América Latina. A competição profissional nesta carreira é acirrada, pois a atuação não é restrita ao farmacêutico por força de lei. Dessa forma, o profissional formado em Farmácia compete com praticamente todos os profissionais de saúde, advogados e até administradores de empresas. Responsabilidades na indústria de medicamentos e em consultorias especializadas: Acompanha os processos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novos produtos; Analisa relatórios de qualificação e validação; Acompanha e avalia o mercado e os lançamentos de novos produtos dos concorrentes; Administra e executa o processo de registro de novos produtos farmacêuticos na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa); Acompanha diariamente as publicações da Anvisa no Diário Oficial da União (D.O.U.); Discute novas resoluções em Consultas Públicas na Anvisa; Acompanha e implementa novas resoluções e regras sanitárias; Recebe e acompanha auditoria sanitária; Administra o processo de revalidação do registro de produtos; Acompanha o sistema de atendimento ao cliente (SAC) e registros do setor de farmacovigilância; Orienta o departamento de marketing em publicidades e propagandas; Orienta o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Verifica os registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento. Responsabilidades nos órgãos reguladores: Acompanha o cumprimento de normas e legislação por parte das empresas; Propõe e debate com o mercado o desenvolvimento de novas resoluções e regulamentações; Fiscaliza a qualidade e o seguimento de regras na produção de produtos farmacêuticos; Fiscaliza a comercialização de produtos farmacêuticos; Regulamenta o preço dos medicamentos; Regulamenta os tipos de medicamentos e suas formas de comercialização; Regulamenta o comércio farmacêutico e suas características de consumo. Orienta e acompanha o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Cuida dos registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento; Orienta e fiscaliza condições de estoque e armazenamento de produtos; Acompanha e fiscaliza condições de transporte e distribuição de produtos farmacêuticos. Áreas de atuação: Indústrias farmacêuticas; Empresas de logística farmacêutica; Consultorias especializadas; Vigilância sanitária de estados e municípios (Visa). O curso de graduação em Farmácia é o mais indicado para profissionais que desejam seguir carreira em Assuntos Regulatórios principalmente na indústria de medicamentos. É importante ressaltar que profissionais que desejam atuar em agências reguladoras, como a Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa), é necessária a aprovação em concurso público específico. O curso de graduação em Direito também têm peso e relevância. Uma especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios é obrigatória. Existe também a opção de especialização em Logística Farmacêutica para os profissionais que atuam especificamente em distribuidoras. Para que o profissional se mantenha atualizado é imprescindível que ele acesse, com periodicidade, o conteúdo específico da área farmacêutica publicado no Diário Oficial da União e o site da Anvisa, para manter-se informado sobre novas legislações e consultas públicas vigentes. O ICTQ - Instituto de Pesquisa e Pós-Graduação para o Mercado Farmacêutico tem em seu portal na internet um canal de notícias atualizado diariamente com as novidades demandadas pela Anvisa, vale a pena acompanhá-lo. O mesmo Instituto é pioneiro no Brasil com curso de especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios na Indústria Farmacêutica, além de oferecer a pós graduação em Gestão, Logística e Distribuição Farmacêutica. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Sponsor architectural decisions for squad-level projects and communicate trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. Manage small-to-moderate initiatives that span multiple stakeholders (Infrastructure peers, infrastructure teams, product engineering, compliance, GRC, procurement). Own the squad's contribution to OKRs, monthly business reviews, and the Area business board. Operate with accountability Hold accountability for the squad's financials within ITSec's guidelines (tooling renewals, headcount, contracts). Operate in compliance with corporate policies and risk-management processes. Lead and mentor others within the squad; contribute to hiring panels across Foundation Security. We Are Looking for a Person Who Has Must-have Engineering Manager experience leading a software/security squad, or strong tech-lead/staff-level background with clear intent and readiness to move into people management. Solid hands-on software engineering background — comfortable reading and reviewing code in at least one of Golang, Clojure, or Python, writing Shell/Python scripts for automation, and reviewing IaC (Terraform, Pulumi). Working knowledge of AWS at scale (multi-account, Organizations, IAM, networking, Security Hub, Config). Familiarity with GCP is a strong plus. Comfort designing and governing preventive controls (SCPs, Organization Policies, admission controllers) and remediation pipelines. Track record of hiring, onboarding, and developing engineers; experience (or strong appetite) for running performance and career conversations. Strong written and spoken communication in English; ability to make complex trade‑offs clear to non-technical stakeholders. Nice-to-have Prior experience building and shipping software products (not only operating off-the-shelf security tools) — internal platforms, services, CLIs, integrations, APIs. Prior exposure to CSPM/CNAPP platforms (any major vendor). Experience supporting regulatory or compliance workstreams (PCI, ISO 27001, banking regulators). Familiarity with Kubernetes runtime security, event-streaming platforms, and large-scale data pipelines. Experience embedding security into AI/ML infrastructure. Hands‑on use of AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to accelerate engineering work and team productivity. Tech stack you'll be exposed to AWS, GCP, Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, Kafka, Golang, Clojure, Python, shell scripting, CSPM/CNAPP platforms, internal data pipelines, Looker/BigQuery, Jira. Direct line of sight to Nubank's regulatory and international expansion programs. A squad that builds its own products in-house — you'll lead software engineers shipping real software, not coordinating ticket queues. A peer group of EMs across Foundation Security (Runtime, Infrastructure, Data) and a senior management layer that operates with full financial and strategic accountability. Exposure to multi-country, multi-cloud problems at the scale of Latin America's largest digital bank. Chance of earning equity at Nubank. Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte). title: Digital Product Manager
description: Digital Product Manager Department: Commercial & Marketing Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Digital Product Manager will be the driving force behind FIFA’s digital direct-to-consumer experiences for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Whilst the role will be based in Rio, the successful candidate will act as an integral member of the global Product & Design team, defining fans’ digital journey across FIFA’s owned and operated platforms, notably including FIFA.com and FIFA’s official mobile app. Reporting to Head of Brand & Marketing, the primary responsibility will involve taking the lead in evolving FIFA’s fan-facing websites and apps specifically for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This will include developing digital activations that support tournament goals and objectives, as well as delivery of commercial value for FIFA’s partners. With the biggest, most ambitious FIFA Women’s World Cup™ on the horizon, this is your chance to help shape the next generation of digital experiences and grow the Women’s game! KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Strategic Vision: Play a leading role in defining and developing FIFA’s digital consumer-facing proposition, specifically ensuring products and experiences reflect local fan behaviours and consumption habits, as well as aligning cultural nuances and emerging trends across Brazil and South America. Fan Engagement: Support FIFA’s audience growth goals by optimizing acquisition, engagement and retention journeys across owned platforms, as well as contributing to first‑party data strategies. Value Generation: Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike. Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament‑time digital operations, delivering high‑traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross‑functional coordination during competition periods. Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27. Governance & Communication: Provide clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross‑functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery. Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer‑first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI‑driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally. Data‑driven Performance: Establish and track key performance indicators, using a blend of behavioural insights and user research to inform product development priorities, optimise product performance and exceed tournament goals and objectives. YOUR PROFILE Education & Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business management or related discipline Relevant product development philosophies, e.g., Agile, are essential Relevant project management qualifications, e.g., PRINCE2, highly beneficial Work Experience: 5+ years of product management experience, demonstrating end‑to‑end experience across the digital product lifecycle; from UX/UI design and roadmap development to rigorous testing and release management. Experience working in a direct‑to‑consumer business, ideally within sports, media or related industries. Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”. Exceptional communication skills—both written and verbal—to succinctly and confidently interact with a wide range of stakeholders up to and including senior FIFA management. Demonstrable experience working autonomously and/or with ambiguity; with an ability to adapt swiftly to organisational change or leverage short‑term opportunities. Competencies: Confidence leading multiple projects with autonomy, often with colleagues and/or suppliers located in different territories and time zones. Passion for developing consumer experiences and thinking big picture; complemented with a demonstrable understanding of digital product development and design principles. Data‑driven with an aptitude for harnessing data, forming KPIs, and leveraging consumer insights to make informed decisions. Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross‑functional teams across FIFA, each with varying degrees of digital maturity and technical understanding. Willingness to travel to other FIFA offices and venues, typically in Zurich, as well as relocating to another location for a period of time, e.g. during FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2027. Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English. Proficiency in another official FIFA language, such as Spanish, is a benefit. Technology: Strong knowledge of digital direct‑to‑consumer ecosystems, including mobile and video. Solid understanding and passion for digital innovation, including application of AI. Experience with industry‑standard solutions, e.g., Figma, Asana and Confluence. Requirements: Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

The position requires a proactive mindset, strong communication skills and the ability to manage priorities in a dynamic operational environment. You should be comfortable working across disciplines, engaging with both operational and project teams, and taking ownership of activities from planning through execution. Lead the projects and tasks related with Operations team offshore. Support onshore organization regarding vendor and equipment verification, site visits, manpower qualifications and FATs. Acquisition: support on material identification/specification and start procurement process (raise MRs). Project Execution: responsible for third parties’ activities in the installation; be a liaison towards crew and onboard management, monitor progress and inspect HSEQ working practices, issue execution daily reports. Project Close‑out: ensure proper completion, material demobilization and project close‑out. Risk Management: identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to reduce project impacts. Documentation: prepare and organize technical project documentation. Communication: assist the Project Engineer being the link with the Offshore crew, lead meetings to provide transparent information, prepare and issue reports. Ensure that the design and construction of equipment & facilities as well as the project execution are compliant with the client’s specification, functional requirements and regulatory requirements. What We Are Looking For Background/Qualifications Technicians/Engineers with technical background. Offshore experience is mandatory (minimum 3 years). Knowledge of technical drawings and equipment datasheets. Hard Skills Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; knowledge of Project and Primavera is an advantage. Proficiency in English (reading, writing and conversation). Ability to read, analyse and interpret technical procedures in both Portuguese and English. Soft Skills Structured, analytical and solution oriented. Team player who can also work independently and take ownership of assigned tasks. Adaptable and flexible, with the ability to respond effectively to changing priorities and unforeseen events. Proactive, with a strong sense of initiative and accountability. Strong coordination and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and collaborate with offshore and onshore teams, contractors and vendors. Leadership skills and the ability to work effectively within a multi‑disciplinary environment. What We Offer We live by our #TEAM values – they always guide our actions, no compromises. People who are committed to excellence, developing their professional experience as they deliver organizational outcomes. Development opportunities where you may be part of internationally based project teams and collaborate with colleagues across our global organization. An open and collaborative workplace where you can have an immediate impact and contribute to the success of our operations. Challenging work in a dynamic offshore and project environment with exposure to a wide range of technical disciplines and stakeholders. A competitive total compensation package including health benefits, pension, incentive programmes and other local benefits. The opportunity to work alongside highly experienced professionals within one of the world’s leading offshore energy infrastructure companies. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Agente Educativo Junior – Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. O Projeto Light – Exposição Itinerante contempla a realização de uma exposição no Centro Cultural Light, representando a história, o impacto social e o protagonismo da Light ao longo de 120 anos na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, juntamente com o desenvolvimento de atividades imersivas com escolas, com foco em educação ambiental e no consumo consciente, eficiente e seguro de energia elétrica. Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio. Por meio deste edital, a AVSI Brasil lança a seleção de um profissional para função de Agente Educativo Jr. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Agente Educativo Jr será responsável por atuar no apoio às exposições e atividades do Centro Cultural Light, assistência e orientação ao público, apoio às atividades educativas, recreativas, imersivas e de lazer, bem como o apoio operacional às atividades programadas pela equipe educativa. Apoiar a recepção, orientação e organização do fluxo de visitantes às exposições e espaços museológicos do Centro Cultural Light; Auxiliar visitantes com necessidades especiais, garantindo acessibilidade adequada e uma experiência inclusiva; Orientar o público quanto às regras de visitação, conservação dos espaços e uso adequado dos equipamentos; Apoiar a execução de atividades recreativas, imersivas e lúdicas programadas pelo Time Educativo do Centro Cultural Educacional Light; Fornecer apoio logístico a atividades educativas, escritórios, visitas mediadas e atividades especiais; Apoiar a montagem, organização e desmontagem de materiais utilizados nas atividades; Contribuir para a manutenção do espaço expositivo, garantindo condições adequadas para a preservação de dois ambientes; Zelar pela correta utilização dos espaços de exposição e pela qualidade da experiência do visitante; Colaborar com a equipe do Time Educativo do Centro Cultural Light, garantindo apoio, segurança e organização durante esses anos; Elaborar relatórios diários das atividades realizadas. Desired Profile Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph. You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Must Haves: 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development. Advanced English communication skills. Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms. Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI). Good to Have: Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB). GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases. Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA). Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments. Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management. Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Principal Package Management Spec
description: Job Overview Principal Package Management Specialist utilizes their technical acumen, commercial acumen, management skills, and leadership skills to oversee all aspects of delivering a package from the cradle to the grave. Their core responsibility is ensuring the package is delivered on budget and on schedule while abiding by Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, and Security (QHSES) and project requirements. A successful Principal Package Management Specialist identifies risks and opportunities, sets up mitigation and captures plans accordingly. This entails developing a strategic outlook for the package and ensuring that all matters are resolved with the involvement of the right stakeholders and in a timely fashion. Principal Package Management Specialist must report status and outlook at an executive level to the Project Management team and, at times, Corporate Management. Responsibilities Deliver a package (purchase orders and/or subcontracts) on budget and schedule, and abide by QHSES and project requirements; complexity, criticality, and value of packages typically vary and are assigned and adjusted at the discretion of the function and project. Maintain a clear and thorough dialogue with the Project Management Team, and provide accurate and periodic status updates as well as both short and long-term outlooks. Identify risks and opportunities, and maintain a strategic outlook throughout the execution of the package; such discussion is to be held periodically with the Project Management team for buy-in. Maintain an accurate account of the package cost, commitments, changes, and forecast. Provide inputs and ensure alignment with Project Controls on current and forecasted cost and schedule. ROS dates to be analyzed with the schedulers to identify priorities and, if applicable, Installation Work Packages and Advance Work Packages to be set up and implemented. Track cost and schedule bid basis against actuals. Interface with all stakeholders to achieve package goals; stakeholders include but are not limited to the Supplier/Subcontractor, Engineering, Supply Chain, QHSES, Construction, Installation (if applicable), Commissioning, Joint Venture Partners, and, as needed, the client. Arrange and attend periodic status meetings with suppliers and clients as required. Manage formal correspondence with suppliers, clients, and other involved parties. Attend key meetings such as the progress meeting, kick-off meeting, PIM, and others. Oversee and enforce all day-to-day applicable processes involved and interface across various functions to identify and resolve any technical or commercial matters, and if unavoidable, then resolve any bottlenecks. Enforce the Management of Change process and Project Change Notices. Oversee the documentation process and manage priorities to ensure the most effective delivery from a cost and schedule aspect; this conversation must be coordinated between the suppliers, McDermott, and the client as applicable. Review key documents such as Technical Bid Evaluations, Commercial Bid Evaluations, Purchase Orders, and supplier data. Work with the end user to ensure alignment and expectations are met. Ensure that the prime contract flow downs are correctly administered, including variations. Oversee the planning, performance, and resource allocation of their team throughout the project. Could potentially report to the Package Manager or Senior Package Manager on a project. Develop and maintain contingency planning and lessons learned. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Engineering or Supply Chain Management (or a relevant discipline). 8-12 years of relevant experience (ideally in Engineering, Project/Package Management, Manufacturing, or similar). Technical knowledge of all phases of an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Installation (EPCI) project and specific knowledge in the domain of the proposed packages is preferred. Commercial knowledge of contracts, purchase orders, and relevant disciplines within the Supply Chain function, such as proposals, purchasing, expediting, logistics, and material management. Strong understanding and adherence to QHSES requirements and ability to ensure compliance. Understands the requisitioning process from the bid stage through clarifications until Purchase Order award and post-award activities such as execution, receiving, and commissioning. Proactive attitude in determining opportunities and risks, particularly those attributed to Quality, Safety, Budget, and Schedule. Characteristics of a leader that naturally relates to all members of the team, from the floor to the project team and executive management. Effective communicator with strong written, verbal, and public speaking skills. Willing to travel to various locations such as the shops, supplier offices and headquarters, job sites, labs, and other relevant locations as needed; at times, there may be a requirement for an extended deployment at a supplier’s location or the job site. PMP and/or PE is a plus. #J-18808-Ljbffr
