title: Staff Security Engineer (IAM) - BR - 2026 Brazil, Belo Horizonte; Brazil, Campinas; Brazil, Rio[...]
description: Staff Security Engineer (IAM) - BR - 2026 Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page About the Role Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution. The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands‑on experience in the domain produces. Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate. What You’ll Be Responsible For Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service‑to‑service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows. Translating least‑privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization‑wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time. Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits. Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence. Designing and facilitating large‑scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement. Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization. Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control. We Are Looking for a Person Who Has Must-have +15 years of professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management. Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid‑course corrections. Expert‑level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production‑quality code in at least one general‑purpose programming language. Demonstrated ability to model identity‑related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions. A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer. Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non‑technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators. Nice-to-have Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks. Hands‑on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak. Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third‑party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure. Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi‑cloud environments. title: Manager, Finance
description: Job Description The Finance Manager is responsible for daily oversight and monitoring of the finance and accounting activities assigned to themselves and/or their team. Additionally, the Finance Manager provides guidance, training, and consultation to employees and finance team members regarding their specific financial services and recruitment of staff as needed. Managers may also be responsible for the maintenance and administration of financial accounting systems supporting their assigned function and maintenance of processes and internal controls within their assigned area. What You Will Do Preparation of periodic budgets and forecasts for the Region(s). Guides in the preparation of statutory accounts and tax returns for ABS and its subsidiary companies. Guide in the preparation of returns relating to personal property, license, annual reports and other miscellaneous returns for ABS and its subsidiary companies. Coordination and administration of external audits. Provide in-depth analysis and reporting of financial information to senior management for purposes of making informed decisions and evaluating performance. Maintain relationships with important vendors, service providers and business partners. Participate in cross functional and/or multi-jurisdictional teams and projects across the ABS organization as needed. Train, supervise, provide guidance, and coordinate the work of the financial staff while assuming accountability for service delivery. Collaborate within the ABS organization to identify and resolve business issues. Drive value and efficiency in assigned processes while minimizing risk and cost. Maintain an effective internal controls environment by ensuring that FSG Policy and Procedural Statements are adhered to in assigned area. Drive the FSG strategy by identifying and implementing innovative solutions and services to improve and simplify processes. What You Will Need Education and Experience Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent in accounting or finance. A minimum of seven (7) years' previous accounting and tax experience in an international service or manufacturing company environment, with some experience in a financial management position. Knowledge, Skills And Abilities Disciplined in relevant accounting or financial concepts and principles. Technically proficient with financial and accounting systems / software. Capacity to analyze, interpret, and report financial data. Good interpersonal skills for dealing with internal and external clients. Good managerial skills in the areas of team leadership, development, organization, planning and implementation. Knowledge of computerized accounting systems, preferably Oracle. A thorough knowledge of ABS and its businesses and processes is also beneficial to providing maximum effectiveness in this position. Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality & Environmental Management System. Reporting Relationships The incumbent reports directly to the Director of Finance. May have individual contributors report to them. title: MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our work demands mastery across electronics, hydraulics, mechanics, systems, and control to create products that survive and perform in harsh, high-temperature, high-load downhole conditions. We are seeking a mechanical technician with 3+ years' experience in lab and field testing of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for downhole drilling systems, including assembly, prototyping, operating, and debugging the associated test equipment. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. The opportunity for you You will own the hands‑on assembly, testing, and maintenance of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for our downhole drilling systems — running functional and performance tests in the lab and supporting prototype bring‑up, qualification campaigns, and operational deployments in the field. You will work alongside mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers, capturing test data and feeding it back into design and reliability improvements. Responsibilities Conduct functional tests, performance evaluations, and calibrations on mechanical and electromechanical equipment to ensure compliance with quality standards and manufacturer specifications. Set up and operate test equipment — pressure and temperature test rigs, hydraulic test benches, torque tools, dimensional metrology (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and data acquisition systems — to run characterization, qualification, and acceptance testing. Diagnose and repair mechanical and hydraulic failures at the component and assembly level, including disassembly, inspection, replacement of worn or damaged parts, and rework of seals, fasteners, and fittings. Support prototype bring‑up and design iterations by capturing test data, flagging anomalies, and feeding observations back to mechanical and systems engineers. Assembly, Field Support & Documentation Assemble, disassemble, inspect, and perform preventative maintenance on mechanical and hydraulic equipment (downhole tools, actuators, drillstring components, pumps, valves, and associated test fixtures) according to technical specifications and procedures. Maintain accurate service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation, and generate clear reports on work performed and equipment status. Provide hands‑on support to field representatives and drilling crews during qualification campaigns and deployments, and travel to field locations when required. Coordinate with other technicians, engineers, and field representatives to resolve complex issues, support failure analysis, and ensure seamless equipment deployment. Help maintain an organized work environment and manage inventory of electronic components, parts, and supplies. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture, adhere to HSE regulations and quality procedures, and help maintain a safe, organized work environment (5S, housekeeping, waste segregation). What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 3+ years of experience working with mechanical and hydraulic equipment, preferably in an industrial or oilfield environment. Technical school certificate in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Proficiency with mechanical and hydraulic test equipment (pressure and temperature rigs, torque tools, hydraulic benches), dimensional metrology instruments (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and hand and power tools. Skilled in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including torque‑controlled fastening, seal and o‑ring installation, and alignment of rotating and reciprocating components. Ability to read, understand, and interpret technical manuals, drawings, schematics, blueprints, and engineering instructions. Experience troubleshooting and repairing mechanical and hydraulic equipment and generating clear service and calibration reports. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Basic computer literacy and familiarity with data acquisition and diagnostic software, plus strong problem‑solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills. Customer Interface & Cross‑Functional Collaboration Experience working alongside engineers, field representatives, and drilling crews to support testing, deployments, and on‑site troubleshooting. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to capture lab and field test observations as clear, actionable feedback for engineering. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence High attention to detail and discipline in service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation. Ability to work independently or as part of a team, executing assigned tasks reliably against schedule and procedures. Contributes to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement based on test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast‑moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands‑on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable on the shop floor, in the lab, and at field locations as required, including travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures while helping refine them as systems and processes mature. Adaptable and resilient in early‑stage and transitioning‑to‑commercial technology environments. Open to giving and receiving constructive feedback that improves equipment performance and reliability. Nice to have Associate degree or higher in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related discipline. Experience with downhole tools, drillstring components, or other oilfield mechanical equipment. Familiarity with calibration management systems and qualification testing standards. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high‑temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra‑deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Posted On 06/23/2026 Job Information City Rio de Janeiro State/Province Rio de Janeiro IT Services Job Description AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas such as application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. WHY JOIN US If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior/Lead QA Automation Engineer to own and evolve automated testing frameworks, introduce AI-assisted QA practices, and define quality engineering strategy across an AI-driven product development environment. You will architect automation across the full testing stack — unit, integration, API, UI, performance, and security — integrate quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, design evaluation frameworks for LLM-based features, and mentor engineers in modern automation and AI-augmented workflows. WHAT YOU WILL DO Own and evolve the organization’s automated testing framework and QA tooling ecosystem. Define and standardize AI-assisted testing practices, including test case/data generation, coverage discovery, and responsible AI guardrails. Implement intelligent test selection, regression analysis, and measurable quality metrics to optimize release quality and reduce risk. Ensure AI-augmented tests remain deterministic, maintainable, production-ready, and supported by traceability, validation, and drift detection. Architect and scale automation across unit, integration, API, UI, contract, performance, and security testing. Champion modern testing principles, integrate automation into CI/CD, and enforce quality gates and release readiness criteria. Design evaluation frameworks for AI-powered features, including prompt robustness, deterministic validation, and human-in-the-loop review where appropriate. Lead root-cause analysis for systemic quality issues and continuously improve automation ROI and test effectiveness. Mentor engineers on modern automation, AI-assisted workflows, prompt engineering, and review standards for AI-generated code. Define and track QA KPIs, provide data-driven Go/No-Go recommendations, and improve testing strategy based on measurable outcomes. Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, and DevOps to embed quality early, influence architecture, and integrate accessibility, security, and privacy testing throughout the SDLC. MUST HAVES 5+ years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles. 3+ years leading automation strategy or serving as a senior technical QA authority. Hands-on experience using AI tools for test generation, refactoring, and automation maintenance. Experience evaluating LLM-based systems (prompt robustness, structured outputs, drift detection, and versioned regression suites). Strong proficiency in at least one programming language (TypeScript, Java, Python, etc.) and modern test frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium). Demonstrated experience designing, maintaining, and scaling test automation frameworks and CI/CD quality gates. Strong understanding of distributed systems, HTTP lifecycle, and database querying (SQL/NoSQL). Experience mentoring engineers and leading quality initiatives with measurable outcomes. NICE TO HAVES Working knowledge of secure testing practices (OWASP Top 10) and performance testing strategy. Familiarity with compliance, privacy, or regulated industry SaaS environments. Experience implementing performance/load testing strategies. Experience with accessibility testing strategy and tooling. PERKS AND BENEFITS Professional growth : Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps. Competitive compensation : USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets. Exciting projects : Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies. Flextime : Flexible schedule with remote and office options. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Cientista de Dados Pleno | Inteligência Social
description: Descrição da vaga A Globoé feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro. Diversidade: Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. title: Profissional Program Planning
description: A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. Além da nossa atuação pelo Brasil, com escritório no Rio de janeiro, São Paulo e Belo Horizonte, temos também filiais nos Estados Unidos, fazendo com que a Radix se consolide cada vez mais como uma empresa global. Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade? Como Profissional Program Planning você vai: Reporte e Governança do Programa Padronizar a forma como os gerentes de projeto reportam status, progresso, riscos, indicadores financeiros e desempenho. Simplificar e automatizar templates de reporte sempre que possível. Criar e manter dashboards executivos que demonstrem a saúde do programa em todos os projetos ativos. Estabelecer uma rotina consistente de reportes, incluindo reuniões semanais, quinzenais ou mensais, conforme necessário. Preparar consolidações e resumos do programa para a liderança e executivos. Garantir que os dados dos projetos sejam precisos, atualizados e acionáveis. Manter visibilidade sobre o desempenho financeiro do programa, incluindo orçamento, realizado, forecast, margem, burn rate e alocação de custos. Consolidar informações financeiras de múltiplos projetos em uma visão única do programa. Identificar lacunas relacionadas ao acompanhamento orçamentário, alocação de recursos, utilização de centros de custo, change orders e previsões financeiras. Sinalizar inconsistências para os gerentes de projeto e para a liderança do programa, permitindo ações corretivas. Apoiar os gerentes de projeto com recomendações quando houver desvios financeiros ou de entrega. Monitorar áreas compartilhadas entre projetos, incluindo recursos comuns, dependências cruzadas e custos não atribuídos. Gestão de Performance da Execução e Riscos Monitorar cronogramas, custos, mudanças de escopo, riscos, problemas, dependências e saúde das entregas em todo o programa. Conduzir reuniões recorrentes de revisão com os gerentes de projeto. Questionar reportes incompletos, pouco claros ou quando o desempenho estiver abaixo do esperado. Identificar riscos antecipadamente e escalá-los com recomendações objetivas. Apoiar a elaboração de planos de ação corretiva para projetos atrasados, acima do orçamento, com falta de recursos ou sem responsáveis claramente definidos. Garantir que riscos, problemas e mudanças contratuais sejam identificados com antecedência suficiente para que a liderança possa atuar. Planejamento de Recursos e Capacidade Apoiar o planejamento de recursos e previsões de capacidade do programa. Monitorar se os recursos estão corretamente alocados aos projetos e centros de custo. Identificar situações de subalocação, sobrealocação e lacunas entre demanda e capacidade disponível. Apoiar a liderança na previsão de necessidades futuras de contratação com base no pipeline de projetos e compromissos de entrega. Ferramentas, Automação e Dados Utilizar ferramentas como Power BI, Pipedrive, Excel e outras plataformas de automação e reporte para aumentar a visibilidade e reduzir esforços manuais. Criar ou aprimorar dashboards que forneçam visibilidade em tempo real ou próxima do tempo real sobre o desempenho dos projetos e do programa. Promover melhorias contínuas nos processos de reporte, templates e qualidade dos dados. Trabalhar em parceria com gerentes de projeto, equipe financeira e liderança para tornar os dados do programa mais confiáveis e úteis para tomada de decisão. Para essa vaga, você deve ter: Experiência em suporte à gestão de projetos, gestão de programas, PMO, controle de projetos ou operações. Sólido entendimento de indicadores financeiros de projetos, incluindo orçamento, realizado, forecast, burn rate, margem e change orders. Capacidade de consolidar informações de múltiplos projetos e identificar tendências, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria. Forte experiência com Power BI, Excel e ferramentas de reporting/dashboard. Capacidade de trabalhar com gerentes de projeto e liderança para melhorar a qualidade dos reportes e a responsabilização dos envolvidos. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e conforto para questionar informações incompletas ou inconsistentes. Capacidade de atuar em um ambiente em crescimento e dinâmico, onde processos ainda estão sendo estruturados e aprimorados. Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details. Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modifications schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements. Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety‑critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation. Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance. Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements. Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi‑disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment. Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions. Analytical and Problem‑Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions. Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence. Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly. Qualifications and Experience Engineering degreeis mandatory. CREA‑RJ accreditation is required. Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage. Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred. Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable. Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders. Why Join Us? At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment. If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production. description: Atuar com as rotinas de farmácia hospitalar, recebendo, armazenando, separando e dispensando medicamentos e materiais, sob a supervisão direta do Farmacêutico. Sobre o Hospital Pedro II - CER Santa Cruz Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Receber, conferir e armazenar os medicamentos e insumos; Controlar o estoque, distribuir, dispensar e fracionar medicamentos; Realizar a conferência da dispensação de medicamentos e insumos, sob supervisão direta do Farmacêutico; Realizar o controle de temperatura do ambiente e geladeira; Confeccionar etiquetas para unitarização de doses de medicamentos; Separar medicamentos por paciente e/ou setores; Controlar os medicamentos devolvidos; Auxiliar na limpeza e organização do setor; Realizar todas as atividades pertinentes ao cargo, sob supervisão direta do Farmacêutico; Realizar atividades de área/ setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor Imediato e padronizações da Instituição. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino médio completo; Curso Técnico em Farmácia completo; Experiência mínima de 06 meses como Técnico de Farmácia ou Auxiliar de Farmácia. Informações adicionais Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.
